task_scope: Bounded independent exact locator and campus-identity review; root separately owns current physical-status and successor adjudication.

baseline.method: All full Point, Polygon and MultiPolygon geometries including holes; containment and equirectangular point-to-segment distance screening. Approximate distance is duplicate-screening only, not survey clearance.

prior_research_review.scope: All sources/research*.json and curated*.json plus the v97 full entity rows searched for Key Point/KeyPoint/SPB DC2/Prokofyeva and Cyrillic variants before capture; no prior candidate match. The unrelated phrase key-points was ignored.

findings.geometry: Exact operator facility-page marker and explicit geographic provider contract close the source-specific campus-point route. No cadastral boundary is needed or claimed.

identity.literal: The operator's own facility page gives Saint Petersburg and Prokofyeva10 litA with the exact marker. Its November13,2025 announcement gives the same project street address. An operator-hosted IKS Media clipping literally names SPB DC2 and the applicant; ABN independently reports the literal DC2 name at the same street/house/litera.
identity.analyst_reconciliation: The same-address single Saint Petersburg project is treated as the SPB DC2 campus. This is an explicit cross-source identity reconciliation, not a claim that the operator facility page itself literally labels the marker SPB DC2. Matching forecasts and dimensions are corroborative only, not the sole identity bridge.
identity.legal_scope: ООО Кей Поинт СПБ is reported by both secondary permit stories. No primary corporate-register or municipal permit record was obtained; no legal ownership, entity merger or permit compliance is selected.
identity.excluded: The Moscow headquarters/contact-map start marker [55.788677,37.589159], other Key Point cities, generic city points, and the three planned phase counts are not selected.

lifecycle.undated_operator_label: The September9-captured facility page says under construction, but no published physical-observation date is bound to it.
lifecycle.historical_source: November13,2025 announcement is outside the fixed freshness window. Neither its later retrieval nor related-story dates refresh it.
lifecycle.permit_sources: June16,2026 permit issue reported June17/18 establishes permission only. It does not demonstrate actual physical construction.
lifecycle.parallel_root_review: Root is adjudicating June23 operator forum coverage and public contractor/operator successors. That work is not claimed performed or accepted here.
lifecycle.remaining_gate: A named-campus authoritative actual-work observation in May22–August20,2026, with bounded completion/cancellation review, remains necessary for admission. A generic current under-construction statement would qualify if its physical observation is genuinely dated; no additional trade-level milestone requirement is imposed.
lifecycle.forecast_scope: Future 2027/2028 phase deliveries are forecasts. No completion, operation, cancellation or exact-start inference is selected.

rights_and_access.scope: Isolated operator-published coordinate and address facts, independently restated identity facts, source attribution and short audit pointers only. No open licence asserted. No raw HTML, provider map tiles, photos, rendering, copyrighted report body, cadastral polygon or source code is redistributed. No geocoder, paid API, user credential or private endpoint used.
rights_and_access.access: Seven ordinary credential-free HTTP200 captures. No API credentials, private endpoint, paywall content, map image or municipal cadastral service was called.
rights_and_access.source_classification: First-party operator facility/announcement and Yandex documentation remain distinct from operator-hosted IKS Media and independent ABN secondary reporting.
rights_and_access.attempted_municipal_discovery: Two bounded web searches for the authority/applicant/address yielded no original municipal permit record selected. No cadastral number or original municipal point claimed.
